index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents a three-stage flowchart illustrating the structured interview methodology used in the study, beginning with participant consent and progressing through three distinct phases: Introductory Phase, Model Output Assessment, and Overall Model Perceptions. The global layout is linear and horizontal, with each phase represented by a large white rectangular box with rounded corners, connected sequentially by thick black arrows indicating the progression of the interview process. At the top left, a black rectangular header labeled 'Consent to Participate in Interview (N = 21)' initiates the flow, pointing downward to the first phase.

In the Introductory Phase, depicted on the left, a light blue circular icon above the box contains two stylized human figures with a speech bubble containing a question mark, symbolizing initial inquiry. Below this, the title 'Introductory Phase' is displayed in bold. Three black rectangular sub-boxes list the components: '1. Background Questions', '2. Share or Draft Additional Post', and '3. Discussion of Shared/Drafted Post'.

The second phase, Model Output Assessment, is centered and features a light blue circular icon with a network graph and a document, representing data analysis and model outputs, above a single human figure. The title 'Model Output Assessment' is in bold. This phase is divided into two stacked sections. The upper section, titled 'Discussion and Ranking of Binary Disclosure Model Outputs', lists two items: '1. "Sensitive" Post' and '2. Burner/Drafted Post'. A thin black arrow points downward to the lower section, titled 'Discussion and Ranking of Categorical Disclosure Model Outputs', which includes three items: '1. "Sensitive" Post', '2. Burner/Drafted Post', and '3. Stranger’s Post'. Both sections have dark gray headers and white content boxes with black text.

The final phase, Overall Model Perceptions, is on the right, with a light blue circular icon showing two human figures and a speech bubble with a checkmark and an 'x', symbolizing evaluation and feedback. The title 'Overall Model Perceptions' is in bold. Three black rectangular sub-boxes list: '1. Model Pros & Cons', '2. Likelihood of Use', and '3. Desired Improvements'.

All phase boxes are connected by thick black rightward-pointing arrows, indicating the sequential flow of the interview. The visual style is clean and minimalistic, using consistent shapes, colors, and typography to convey a clear, step-by-step methodology. The figure effectively communicates the structured progression from initial participant engagement, through model output evaluation, to final perceptions and feedback.
